caption: The drawing shows a single, large, collar-shaped object, colored in a muted gray tone, centered on a beige or off-white background. The collar is a crescent or horseshoe shape, with its inner edge forming a smooth, curved line and its outer edge decorated with a border of closely spaced black dots and a band of floral embroidery. The floral embroidery design runs along the outer border, featuring clustered leaves, small circular elements, and flower motifs rendered in fine black ink outlines. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a small sketch of a stylized bird facing right, and in the upper right corner, there is a sketch of branches with leaves and a looped tendril, also drawn in fine lines. The name "MARIE FAUX BRO" is lightly inscribed at the bottom right of the central rectangle, and a number or date "3-1-731" appears in the same area. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the collar design occupying the majority of the space within a faint rectangular border, and the two smaller sketches appearing separately in the upper region.
title: Embroidered Collar
